FMAG.description: Moment Magnifier Factors (FMAG). Holds the first- and second-order moment magnification factors about the local y and z axes; each factor must satisfy 1.0 <= value < 100.0 (hard-enforced by the handler).

B1Y_DELTA_BY.description: B1y - Delta by, first-order moment magnifier about the y-axis. Must satisfy 1.0 <= value < 100.0.

B1Z_DELTA_BZ.description: B1z - Delta bz, first-order moment magnifier about the z-axis. Must satisfy 1.0 <= value < 100.0.

B2Y_DELTA_SY.description: B2y - Delta sy, second-order moment magnifier about the y-axis. Must satisfy 1.0 <= value < 100.0.

B2Z_DELTA_SZ.description: B2z - Delta sz, second-order moment magnifier about the z-axis. Must satisfy 1.0 <= value < 100.0.
